name: powerops
description: Plan, review and gate Microsoft Power Platform builds: powerops-plan turns an idea into a signed-off plan, powerops-prototype sketches its screens, powerops-review-sketch judges each sketch in a fresh context, powerops-review-plan reviews it in a fresh context, and powerops-implement builds only from a signed-off plan, handing the build to Microsoft's skills. After the build, powerops-verify checks it against the plan and powerops-review-security reads it for security, each in a fresh context. It also starts the PowerOps MCP server (`powerops mcp`), whose tools check, diff, test and plan a deploy, and import only after the user types the target's name. Needs the `powerops` CLI on PATH: see Install in the PowerOps README. The portable powerops-specialists skill supplies six advisory domain procedures across clients; findings are record-only and their effectiveness is not evaluated.
